idea_0: Halfway through a job. Phone rings. You miss it. **That's £300-500 gone.**
Small trade firms miss **30-40% of inbound calls.** Not a guess. That's the data.
Every missed ring is a customer **phoning your competitor next.**
You're on-site 8 to 5. Nobody's covering the phone. **The leak runs all day.**
An answering service that picks up every call, captures the job, **books you in.**
Andy Norman, founder of Antek Automation. **30+ years in field service.**
idea_1: Voice AI used to be **enterprise-only.** Big budgets. Deep pockets.
Not anymore. Now within reach of a **two-person trade firm.**
This isn't the old press-1 menu. **It holds a real conversation.**
It understands the caller, **books the appointment,** takes the details.
Half your day is fielding calls. **This covers it.**
Andy Norman, founder of Antek Automation. **30+ years in field service.**
idea_2: Enterprise AI is getting **more complex,** not less.
Your firm doesn't need that. **You need the phone answered.**
Chase the platform that promises power and flexibility...
...or deploy a tool that **answers calls today.**
Most firms need the second one. **Stop losing callers to voicemail.**
idea_3: AI answers calls 24/7. Qualifies leads. **Never takes lunch.**
Run it completely unsupervised and you **create new problems.**
Service businesses sell trust. **Trust needs judgment.**
An angry caller needs **de-escalation,** not a script.
AI handles the volume. **Humans handle the judgment.**
idea_4: Grok Build. Claude Code. Codex. The race for coding tools.
If you run a law firm, **none of this matters to you.**
You don't need to build custom software.
You need the phone answered and the **consult booked while they're keen.**
Automating intake isn't a coding project. **It's a workflow.**
idea_5: They're asking ChatGPT **which lawyer to call.**
Old SEO assumed people click blue links. **That model is dying.**
AI answer engines give the answer directly. **No website visit.**
If they don't name your firm, **you're invisible.** AEO fixes that.
idea_6: Most firms treat content like a checklist. **One thin page each.**
Then wonder why a rival **owns position one.**
Not writing more. **Covering every angle** of your practice area.
That signals to Google you're the **definitive local resource.**
idea_7: Schema markup: a **small block of code** on your website.
It tells AI exactly **who you are and what you do.**
It won't write content. It won't win snippets. **It confirms your facts.**
Name, services, area, hours. **No doubt left.**
Google, Gemini, ChatGPT decide if you appear. **Make their job easy.**
Andy Norman, founder of Antek Automation. **30+ years in field service.**
idea_8: Google's AI Overviews now answer **before the organic results.**
One synthesised answer, **right at the top.**
The sources it trusts? Reddit. Gov sites. Forbes. **Not your competitors.**
If you rely on organic leads, **this changes everything.**
Are you the kind of source **the AI pulls from at all?**
idea_9: Big enterprises are **failing at AI.** Years. Spiralling budgets.
Most initiatives **never make it past pilot.**
A three-person practice can deploy **in a week.**
Your size isn't a limitation. **It's your advantage.**
idea_10: Autonomous AI agents look **impressive in demos.**
But every inbound call to your firm is **potential revenue.**
Miss a detail. Mishandle a lead. **Breach confidentiality.**
You haven't lost a task. **You've lost a retainer.**
Purpose-built beats general-purpose **when the stakes are high.**
idea_11: Canned chatbots. Scripted voice assistants. **You've tried them.**
They promise the world. **Most feel like a mediocre contractor.**
Here's why: they're **output generators built for novices.**
Not process partners built for **people who know their craft.**
The right system **fits how you already work.**
Andy Norman, founder of Antek Automation. **30+ years in field service.**
idea_12: Hire a writer. Publish a few posts. **Hope Google notices.**
It rarely moves the needle on **new client calls.**
Content engineering treats content as a **system, not a guess.**
Start with what people search. **Build to rank and convert.**
idea_13: Physical robots still **can't fold a towel.**
AI voice agents answer **thousands of business calls a day.**
The ChatGPT moment for the phone **already happened.**
Voice AI crossed from experimental to **operational. It works now.**
